name: Envenomed Thorns Trap

source.title: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

disable: DC 18 Thievery check (trained) to remove the trip wire.

items.name: Thorny Branch
items.text:
Trigger The trip wire is touched

---

Effect The trap's poisoned thorns attack the creature or object touching the trip wire.

text: A trip wire strung 4 feet above the ground releases a branch studded with envenomed thorns.
